name: Graphic designers
oneLiner: Split in two: the poster is being automated, and the brand system behind it is not.
why: The work that survives is the brief, the system and the argument for a choice, not the artwork
Someone is still answerable when a logo, a claim or an accessibility failure ships
Taste is negotiated with a client, not specified in a prompt, and the negotiation is the job
threats: US employment is projected to shrink 2% to 2035, and every projected opening is a replacement, not growth
UK entry-level postings for graphic designers fell 28% in the year to April 2026
Freelance image-creation posts fell 17% within eight months of image generators
The production half of the role splits off cleanly, which is what makes it automatable

metrics.label: UK entry-level hiring, year to April 2026
Freelance image-creation posts, eight months after image AI

claims.text: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics projects graphic designer employment to fall 2% between 2025 and 2035, from 253,100 jobs — a loss of 4,200 — and names automated design tools such as AI as a factor that makes designers more productive and reduces the need for them.
About 16,000 graphic design openings are projected each year to 2035, and BLS expects all of them to come from replacing workers who leave the occupation rather than from growth.

The adjacent design occupations are not shrinking: BLS projects art directors to grow 4% (5,900 jobs, $114,850 median) and web developers and digital designers 5%, with a $104,000 median for web and digital interface designers.

In the UK, entry-level graphic designer hiring fell 28% in the year to April 2026, the second-steepest decline of 38 tracked occupations after accountants at −29% — though the authors note these roles are also hiring less at every seniority level and call this not yet causal evidence of AI.
Across a large freelancing platform, job posts for image creation fell 17% within eight months of image-generating AI arriving, and the work that remained was more complex and better paid.

Canva's November 2026 restructure affects 1,271 roles, 22% of its workforce, through cuts, role changes and relocations; the chief executive's note attributes it to slowing growth, collapsed layers and co-location, and does not name AI.
